fit.optimizer: AdamW, only native fusion parameters; frozen original RGB encoder/head in evaluation mode.
fit.precision: Frozen GPU RGB encoder FP16; auxiliary module, frozen train head and loss FP32. CPU engineering uses FP32 encoder. No CPU/GPU numerical parity claim.
fit.determinism: Seed0, deterministic algorithms/CuDNN, CuBLAS4096:8, TF32 disabled; past memory and optical flow detached before every frame. Actual GPU engineering must pass before fitting.

Train_delivery.address_schedule: SeedSequence([0, one-based epoch]) shuffles sorted video order; frames remain chronological within each video. Short tails retained. No cross-video clips.
Train_delivery.weighting: Natural video duration, including the long PF-001 video, not balanced per-video sampling. Standard foreground-normalized YOLOX loss per clip, including short tails.
Train_delivery.temporal_state: Continues across adjacent clips and optimizer updates within each video; resets between videos/epochs and on unavailable cue. Stop gradient through every past state, no BPTT. Past training states may have been computed before a parameter update.
Train_delivery.unavailable: Flat scalar cue is unavailable. All-unavailable clips deliver frames but skip AdamW instead of fabricating a gradient update. Report delivered clips and actual updates separately.
Train_delivery.proof: Actual delivered per-epoch addresses/digests and unique frame coverage; original GT/calibration hashes. No Dev/Test labels are accessible to the fit.

budget_and_Dev.sequential_introduction: At stage6 finish each three-cue variant and its complete Dev before starting the next enabled mechanism. All nine are mandatory even if earlier Dev is negative.
budget_and_Dev.extension: After all nine curves and both IR interventions through stage6 or9, extend all nine by3 full epochs iff any normal variant/cue improves best HOTA by more than0.2pp against best through stage-3. Stop by12; one fixed12-epoch cosine horizon.
budget_and_Dev.selection: Original276-column officialCSV COMBINED HOTA___AUC*100, AssA andIDF1 with full precision; higher HOTA,AssA,IDF1, earlier epoch, then registered variant order. Complete normal IR curves only choose primary before Test.
budget_and_Dev.controls: Each of9normal fits own complete Dev best. Strong RGB/gray controls use primary variant and own complete Dev best. Original canonical RGB and fresh sequentialB1 RGB retained.
budget_and_Dev.Dev: All4834Dev frames at every executed epoch; every IR normal snapshot also actual-image-roll andunavailable. No skipping negative normal fits.

removals.eligibility: Only when normal IR primary exceeds complete Dev canonical RGB,fresh RGB,same-variant RGB andgray. Otherwise preserve all9Test and report failed architecture, no Test-based triggering.
removals.reuse: If complete arm semantic computation key exactly matches a normal IR fit, use that same fit/checkpoint provenance. Never reuse by scores or descriptive IDs.
removals.selection: Retain every removal complete Dev curve; evaluate its own Dev best and epoch paired with primary. No Test promotion.
removals.quality_scope: Disables the frame-quality MLP only; spatial context and native contrast remain.
removals.spatial_scope: Disables learned spatial logit only; framequality and enabled redundancy remain.
removals.redundancy_scope: Disables explicit rho suppression only; abs/product spatial features remain. Not elimination of all possible redundancy handling.

runtime.excludes: Weight loading and offline fixedDiffV2IRgeneration; report separately, not full15985-frameFPS

execution.prerequisite: All currently registered chains including conditional fusion_factorial scientific export and actual producer exits. No new CUDA before complete release and real GPU engineering.

contribution: Paired positive complete Dev/Test versus strong cue controls and enabled-module removal are necessary, not sufficient for novelty. Three switch combinations are one candidate family, not9architectures.
